h: Melania Trump reportedly helps secure temporary Russia-Ukraine ceasefire for Oleshky evacuation
p: A temporary ceasefire has reportedly been agreed to let elderly residents leave the town of Oleshky, with Melania Trump said to have played a part.
more: The pause is said to be limited to the evacuation of older residents.
